title: Pushover Notifications
description: Configure your Pushover account credentials. Find these at pushover.net.

appToken.label: Application Token
appToken.help: Your Pushover Application Token — create one at pushover.net/apps/build.

userKey.label: User Key
userKey.help: Your Pushover User Key — shown on your Pushover dashboard.

groupKey.label: Group Key (optional)
groupKey.help: For sending to a delivery group instead of a single user. Leave empty if not using groups.

rateLimitPerMinute.label: Rate Limit (requests per minute)
rateLimitPerMinute.help: Maximum Pushover notifications allowed per IP address and per user per minute. Set to 0 to disable rate limiting.
